description: This file defines a React component 'ToolTestPanel' that provides a UI for testing and displaying results of a specified tool. It manages input parameters, shows execution status, and renders various result formats including formatted text and JSON.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission by converting input values according to their schema and invoking the onSubmit callback with properly formatted data.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies the given text to the clipboard, using the modern Clipboard API if available, otherwise falling back to document.execCommand.

methods.name: handleCopyResult
methods.description: Copies the JSON stringified result to the clipboard and shows a success or failure notification.

methods.name: handleCopyToolName
methods.description: Copies the tool name to the clipboard and shows a notification.
